name: Power Math
description: An offline scientific calculator for Android with exact fractions, symbolic algebra, equation and inequality solvers with step-by-step solutions, and interactive graphing.
features: Exact fraction, surd and pi results, plus Decimal and Scientific modes
Solve linear, quadratic and polynomial equations, polynomial inequalities and linear systems, with the discriminant and steps
Interactive graphing with pan, zoom, roots, vertex and extrema
Saved variables and functions, history and settings that persist
Shift, Alt and Ctrl keypad layers, DEG/RAD modes and hardware keyboard support
Accent colours (yellow, red, blue, green, purple), dark and light themes, adjustable key and text size
Fully offline, no ads, no tracking
